name: pele
title: Pele
description: Create Mermaid diagrams with Pele. Preview, copy, and save PNG or SVG images locally.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: pele
commands.title: Create Diagram
commands.subtitle: Pele
commands.description: Render Mermaid code from selected text or the clipboard, or write a diagram with themes and PNG or SVG export.

tools.name: generate-diagram
tools.title: Generate Diagram
tools.description: Render complete Mermaid syntax with Pele and save a PNG or SVG image locally. Returns a link to the actual rendered file and its dimensions. Local images cannot be displayed inline in Raycast AI Chat.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: theme
preferences.title: Default Theme
preferences.description: Theme used for new diagrams. You can change it in the editor.

preferences.name: scale
preferences.title: PNG Resolution
preferences.description: Resolution multiplier for PNG images. Large diagrams are limited to 16 megapixels or 8,192 pixels per side.

preferences.name: transparent
preferences.title: Transparent Background
preferences.label: Use a transparent canvas background
preferences.description: Node fills and labels retain the theme colors.

preferences.name: saveFolder
preferences.title: Save Folder
preferences.description: Folder for exported diagrams. Defaults to Downloads/Pele.

ai.instructions: When asked to create or convert a diagram, produce complete valid Mermaid syntax and pass it as mermaid to generate-diagram. Preserve supplied YAML frontmatter config. Express requested diagram settings such as Sankey showValues, nodeWidth, and nodePadding in the frontmatter config. Use the requested theme, format, and transparency when specified. The tool renders locally with Pele and saves the file. After success, output the returned markdown verbatim as your response. It links to the actual Pele image and explains that Raycast AI Chat cannot display local images inline. Never output a Mermaid code block as a preview: Raycast would redraw it with a different renderer, layout, and styling. Do not replace the link with a bare file path, invent sandbox paths, or use Markdown image tags for local files. Do not claim the image was copied, opened, uploaded, or displayed inline. Do not call the tool again after a successful result unless the user requests a change. Pele supports built-in Mermaid diagram types, but uses its own layout and themes. Remote images and links are disabled.
